summary_bullets: Use one canonical Python helper for PR-body issue-closing lines.
Prevent longer issue numbers from masking shorter Closes links.
Remove unused PR-body surface while preserving Mermaid and redaction checks.
commit_message:
Reconcile Python Closes helper

Route PR body Closes composition through tracking_issue.link_pr_closes, make the helper prefix-collision safe, remove the dead PrBodyParts dataclass, and add regression coverage.

oos_observations.title: Python version-bump parity tests receive no bash BUMP_TYPE output
oos_observations.description: During this python-only cleanup, make py-test and relevant-checks failed in test_version_bump parity cases because the bash classify helper stdout parsed to an empty key/value map while the Python classifier returned bump types. The touched pr_body/tracking_issue tests passed separately.
